node.title: Sharp FPC5 support distance alone permits exponential abstract families
node.statement: At the sharp endpoint, write L=ell-2. A Gilbert greedy construction gives abstract (2L+1)-subsets of the (5L+5)-point core with pairwise intersections at most L-1 and cardinality at least binom(5L+5,2L+1)/sum_(i<=L+1) binom(2L+1,i)binom(3L+4,i), whose binary-log exponent is (0.099865...+o(1))L. Adjoining the fixed (L-1)-point background gives the exact combined weight and overlap cap 2s. Thus support distance alone cannot prove polynomiality. No locator-flat membership or FPC5 counterexample is claimed.
